description:
Solve a captcha on a web page and return the token / cookie / text needed to pass it.
Use when an authorised browser or HTTP automation is blocked by reCAPTCHA (v2, v3, Enterprise), Cloudflare Turnstile, DataDome or an image captcha.
Before calling: identify the type and read the sitekey from the page (call list_captcha_types for where to find it and which fields each type needs).
Required: recaptcha_* and turnstile → url + sitekey; datadome → url + challengeUrl + proxy; image → body (base64).
Waits for the result (up to ~50 s by default, polling automatically). If it is still solving at the end, it returns the task id: call get_task with it instead of solving again.
Each successful solve is billed to the CaptchaNo balance (cost is returned); failed solves are free. Do not call repeatedly for the same captcha: one token is valid for one submission and expires in about 2 minutes, so use it right away.

action.description: Action name for recaptcha_v3 / recaptcha_enterprise (from grecaptcha.execute) or Turnstile data-action.

body.description: image only (required): the captcha image, base64-encoded (a data:image/...;base64, prefix is accepted).

cData.description: Turnstile only: value of data-cdata / the cData render option, if present.

challengeUrl.description: DataDome only (required): the full captcha URL from the blocked response (iframe src / redirect), including its query string.

invisible.description: recaptcha_v2 / recaptcha_enterprise: true when the widget is invisible (no checkbox).

minScore.description: recaptcha_v3 only: minimum score the token must reach, 0.1-0.9.

pageData.description: Turnstile only: chlPageData value when the captcha is a Cloudflare challenge page rather than a widget.

password.description: Proxy password, if the proxy needs auth.

username.description: Proxy username, if the proxy needs auth.

proxy.description: Proxy the solve should run through: "http://user:pass@host:port" (schemes http, socks4, socks5) or an object. Required for datadome; optional otherwise.

sitekey.description: Site key from the page (data-sitekey / k= / render= parameter). Required for recaptcha_* and turnstile.

type.description: Captcha kind: recaptcha_v2 (checkbox / invisible), recaptcha_v3 (score, no widget), recaptcha_enterprise, turnstile (Cloudflare), datadome, image (OCR).

url.description: Full URL of the page that shows the captcha. Required for every type except image.

userAgent.description: User-Agent of the browser/HTTP client that will use the solution. Recommended so the solution matches your client.

name: solve_captcha

id.description: Task id; pass to get_task to fetch the result again (kept 10 minutes).

sessionSpend.description: Spend tracked by this MCP server process (CAPTCHANO_MAX_SPEND_USD).

userAgent.description: User-Agent the solution is bound to; reuse it when present.

title: Solve a captcha
